tag.description: release tag of the llama.cpp build shipped with the app; null when unreadable

messages.description: the summary of earlier messages included

parts.description: may sum to a little more or less than used: used is the estimate

size.description: 0 when the chat's model is not installed

cuda.description: ready: installed for the pinned tag; stale: only an older one

current.description: 409 config_conflict only: the section as it is now

memory.description: null unless the model is ready; measured, else the fit estimate

quant.description: null when the file name has no quantisation label

tags.description: Code, Vision, MoE, Embeddings, in that order

seq.description: read the run's events on /api/events from after this seq

chatId.description: omit to start a new chat

model.description: omit for the chat's model, or for a new chat the last one named

replace.description: last: retract the chat's last turn and send it again (with text: edited)

requestId.description: the client's id for this send; the same id again answers the same run

token.description: a ui-scoped token for this core run; send it as Authorization: Bearer

partial.description: the answer was cut off by a stop or a failure

time.description: Unix ms when the message was written
